definitions.explanation: publicly criticizing and accusing someone of wrongdoing; calling out misconduct

examples.japanese: ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{糾弾|きゅうだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{汚職|おしょく}→汚職：17399_oshoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{糾弾|きゅうだん}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The politician's corruption was severely condemned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{糾弾|きゅうだん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The opposition party denounced the government's response.

notes:
{糾弾|きゅうだん} means to strongly condemn or denounce wrongdoing ({糾|きゅう} investigate + {弾|だん} attack/criticize) — stronger than ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧ and implying public moral accusation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{糾弾|きゅうだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to denounce wrongdoing
- {糾弾|きゅうだん}⟦{決議|けつぎ}→決議：16467_ketsugi⟧: censure resolution
- ⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{糾弾|きゅうだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to harshly condemn

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {糾弾|きゅうだん}: strong, public, morally charged
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧: ordinary criticism, less severe
- ⟦{非難|ひなん}→非難：14616_hinan⟧: blame, criticism
- ⟦{弾劾|だんがい}→弾劾：20520_dangai⟧: formal impeachment

REGISTER: Formal; common in news and political discourse.
